capabilities: Play typewriter or mechanical keyboard sounds while typing
Adjust sound volume for all keys
Enable or disable key sounds via the command palette
Download additional sound resources from the release page
extras: Not yet available in the community plugin market; must be installed manually or via BRAT. Still in early development, with a roadmap including custom sound sources, recorder/editor integration, and support for Monkey type and Mechvibes resource formats.
motivation: The author built it based on a forum discussion that contained many design suggestions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play typing sounds, so users who want typewriter or mechanical-keyboard feedback while writing have no option.

relations.evidence: You can add register this repo path in the BRAT plugin to install
The first batch of sound schemes are taken from the Click Clack plugin of Writemonkey 3.

summary: Sound plugin that plays typewriter or mechanical keyboard sounds as you type in the editor.
